source: Find Little Outings Phoenix 2026–27 guide; Phoenix Zoo

guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Phoenix this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: ZooLights
items.blurb: Five million lights along two miles of trail, a lake light show and a light tunnel. Most animals aren't out at night.
items.blurbEs: Cinco millones de luces en dos millas de sendero, espectáculo de luces en el lago y un túnel de luz.

items.name: Las Noches de las Luminarias
items.blurb: Thousands of hand-lit luminarias line the desert trails, with live music along the way.
items.blurbEs: Miles de luminarias encendidas a mano en los senderos del desierto, con música en vivo.

items.name: Mesa Temple Christmas Lights
items.blurb: A free stroll through hundreds of thousands of lights, plus an international nativity exhibit across the street.
items.blurbEs: Un paseo gratis entre cientos de miles de luces y una exhibición internacional de nacimientos.

items.name: Christmas at the Princess
items.dates: Through Jan 2; Mon–Thu 5–10 PM, Fri–Sun 4–11 PM
items.blurb: Millions of lights, an outdoor ice rink, a giant Ferris wheel, rides and Santa.
items.blurbEs: Millones de luces, pista de hielo, una gran rueda de la fortuna, juegos y Santa.

items.name: Glendale Glitters
items.blurb: The 33rd year of lights in historic downtown Glendale, kicking off Nov 27 at 5:30 PM with Santa and vendors.
items.blurbEs: El año 33 de luces en el centro histórico de Glendale, con inicio el 27 de noviembre con Santa y vendedores.

items.name: Holiday Lights at McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park
items.addr: 7301 E Indian Bend Rd, Scottsdale, AZ 85250
items.blurb: A train ride through the light displays plus a carousel. It sells out every year.
items.blurbEs: Un paseo en tren entre las luces y un carrusel. Se agota cada año.
